steps.content: MBCC Barriers... You know it's just props, but you couldn't help but feel on edge.

steps.speaker: Soldier A
steps.content: Chief, an event of Mania is in place, please advise!
You're startled and about to respond intuitively, but someone else has spoken first.

steps.speaker: MBCC Chief
steps.content: Such a scene, just send a few Sinners in, set up a few more lines of defense, and keep them away from me.

steps.speaker: Soldier A
steps.content: That's our Chief! Straight to the point!

Seems like someone else is the Chief here. Though this person seems to have a huge misunderstanding about what it takes to be an MBCC Chief... What kind of Chief hides behind lines of defenses instead of facing Corruptors in the frontlines?
The "MBCC Chief" takes a look at you, and flicks his hair smoothly, while you stand dumbfounded.

steps.speaker: MBCC Chief
steps.content: Sinners, such powerful and easy pawns to command! What's your problem? Envious of my schedule?
You don't remember Sinners being "easy" to command.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Black Rings, Mania in Eastside, Syndicate conflicts, The Rust pollution... All the issues related to Mania and Sinners are within MBCC's jurisdiction, so I heard.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We can't leave Sinners risking their lives for us alone.

steps.speaker: MBCC Chief
steps.content: Woah... is this what the job is like? Although it's very prestigious...

steps.speaker: MBCC Chief
steps.content: Cough, it seems that I can't fully utilize my talents here at MBCC, I've decided to transfer! To the city council!
The subordinates gathered around and applauded enthusiastically. You think about it, if you want to be a relaxed, happy, powerful and superior person, um, the city council is quite suitable.
He didn't forget to appreciate your suggestion.

steps.speaker: MBCC Chief
steps.content: You're quite clever. If there's a chance in the future, I'll give you a leg up.
